verdict.rationale: Pipecat ships an official MCP server through its CLI: `pipecat context-hub install` registers the hub as an MCP server with the user's coding agent, and a runtime probe confirms the CLI exists. Its documented scope is a local docs/examples/API index for coding agents, not an MCP surface for operating Pipecat Cloud or running bots, so the story is only partly covered. Missing for 10: MCP tools for managing Cloud agents, sessions, deployments, secrets or builds; documented MCP tool list and transport details; independent or hands-on corroboration of an agent connecting through the MCP server.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: pipecat context-hub install registers the hub as an MCP server with your coding agent and builds the local index
